content.text:
mise: NOT FOUND
node: NOT FOUND
npm: NOT FOUND
npx: NOT FOUND
hk: NOT FOUND
aws: NOT FOUND
fnox: NOT FOUND
git: /usr/bin/git
jq: NOT FOUND
---node---
---npmrc---
engine-strict = true
ignore-scripts = true
---os---
PRETTY_NAME="Ubuntu 22.04.5 LTS"
NAME="Ubuntu"
VERSION_ID="22.04"
root

observation.command: cd /workspace && for t in mise node npm npx hk aws fnox git jq; do printf "%s: " "$t"; command -v "$t" || echo "NOT FOUND"; done; echo "---node---"; node --version 2>/dev/null; npm --version 2>/dev/null; echo "---npmrc---"; cat .npmrc; echo "---os---"; cat /etc/os-release | head -3; whoami
